text:
alex.w: Quick status check on Console Observability roadmap — focusing on dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestones. Can owners confirm milestone dates and any blockers? Trying to align with infra sync next Wed.

priya: Dashboards update — core panels are built, dashboards wired to event-store but perf feed from eng-infra is delayed. If infra hotfix lands today we can ship by Fri EOD. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/422

marco: Tracing hooks status — I own hooks for generator/api routes. PR posted, needs schema review from @jamie and a small change for the traces SDK upgrade. Blocker: sampling config requires a platform flag (cc @eng-infra).

jamie: I can review schema today. One note: error-analysis views need the trace tag `llm.op` to correlate model calls — will that be easy to add?

carmen.ml: We can add `llm.op` on the runtime side, plan to ship tomorrow morning but will need a 15m deployment window and a short canary.

alex.w: Good. Retention question — product wants 90d default, cost recommends 30d. Who owns the retention rollout + migration plan? Need plan for backfill and opt-in toggle.

priya: I can own the migration plan. Proposed config snippet for rollout:
```
retention_default_days: 30  # start
retention_target_days: 90  # final after opt-in window
migration_window_days: 7
```
Will draft runbook and migration job. Need SRE to approve backfill throttling.

sre-bot: Canary scheduled: 2025-11-04T02:00:00Z (canary-id: c-992). Will post results here. :robot_face:

marco: Also pinging about dependency: traces-sdk -> 1.4.0 requires adapter change in console (PR #430). That adapter change is small but needs coordination with the release cut.

jamie: Reviewing both PRs now. Who owns alert thresholds for the new dashboards? I can set initial defaults but product needs to sign off.

product-ops: We'll take conservative defaults to reduce noise. I'll review thresholds and sign off by Thursday.

alex.w: Action items recap: priya — migration plan + runbook; marco — tracing PR + SDK adapter; jamie — schema + alerts defaults; carmen.ml — runtime tag; product-ops — alert signoff; infra — perf feed ETA. If anything slips, reply here or ping me directly. :thumbsup:

priya: Adding tasks to the sprint board and linking runbook draft.

marco: Noted, will land the adapter change after Jamie approves.

sre-bot: Canary completed: SUCCESS (c-992). No anomalies detected. Logs: https://sre.internal/canaries/c-992

alex.w: Thanks everyone — i'll collate and send a short update to roadmap deck post-sync.
